title: A matrix save makes one Audit Log entry with each change
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one range from $0.00 and Default on Markup % 50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 60 in Default's first range.
  5. Type 10 in tier A's first range.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  8. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Default reads 60.

Step 5:

  • Tier A reads 10.

Step 6:

  • The grid saves.

Step 7:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 8:

  • A dialog titled "Audit Log:" and matrix A's name opens.
  • The newest entry is one entry for this save.
  • Its details show Default's change from 50% markup to 60% markup and tier A's new rule, with your user and today's date and time.
  • Each change reads as a label, the old value, an arrow and the new value.
